name: kleingartenverein24
tagline: Kleingartenverein24 is a modern SaaS platform for allotment garden associations, garden clubs and local federations
description: Kleingartenverein24 is a modern SaaS platform for allotment garden associations, garden clubs and local federations. It helps volunteer boards manage members, garden plots, documents, communication and recurring association workflows in one central system. The project is built from real-world association work, not as a generic management tool. Through voluntary work with the Dresden allotment garden association ecosystem, Kleingartenverein24 is developed close to the people who actually use it:
